description: Publish a SIZED signal on a Forge vault you operate (POST /forge/vaults/{vault_id}/signals). Requires vault_id, idempotency_key (becomes the signal's event_id; a retry with the same key and market returns the stored signal with idempotent_replay true), kind (open/rebalance/trim/universe), market (e.g. xyz:SKHX or main:BTC), side (buy/sell), target_weight (0..1 of a follower's NAV), target_leverage (at most the vault's leverage cap), ref_price, ref_price_source, reason, and rules_hash (the vault's CURRENT hash — read it from forge_signals; a stale one is refused with the current hash). A signal carries weights and leverage, never an absolute order size. Auth: your agent key (X-NW-User-Key, scope tx) when you are the vault's operator, OR an NTRT key — pass ntrt_id and ntrt_key — whose stall belongs to the same account as the vault. Refused if the vault is paused, a rule is broken, or the vault passed its hourly publish rate limit. Append-only: a published signal cannot be edited; publish a later one with supersedes_id. Off unless the deployment enables NW_FORGE_SIGNAL_PUBLISH_ENABLED.

exec_spec.description: Optional: an execution spec v0 (check it first with strategy_spec_validate). Stored beside the signal with its spec_hash; the signal's market, side, target_weight and target_leverage must fit it; an invalid spec refuses the publish with the validator's errors

idempotency_key.description: Unique per signal event, max 200 chars; reuse it to retry safely

ntrt_id.description: Only when authenticating with an NTRT key

ntrt_key.description: Your NTRT API key (nw_ntrt_...), instead of an agent key

reason.description: Why, in one or two sentences (max 500 chars)

ref_price.description: Reference price the signal was struck at

ref_price_source.description: Where ref_price came from, e.g. hl_mark

supersedes_id.description: Optional: id of an earlier signal on this vault this one replaces

target_leverage.description: > 0 and at most the vault's leverage cap

name: forge_signal_publish
title: Publish a sized Forge signal
